decision.explanation: Both 'Tabatha Rosproy' and 'Juliana Urtubey' are cited in separate documents (D2S1 and D3S1 respectively) as being named the 2021 National Teacher of the Year by the Council of Chief State School Officers (CCSSO). Since both claims are directly sourced and refer to distinct individuals, they are treated as valid and complementary answers under the same title.
